title: 天皇賞（春）の後に・パレードを率いて

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Trainer, I ran so well today, all the way to the finish line!
choice_data_list: Congratulations on beating T.M. Opera O!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Thank you. I only got there first because of your help.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: W-waaait?! Is this really okay? Shouldn't victory go to the main character instead?

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Drat! I foiled myself! Was I too concerned with running in my Overlord pomp?! Just when did you—
They both seem appalled. However, a race is a race—and a win is a win.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Even though it was just a fluke, I feel a little more confident knowing that I can beat Opera O.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: I'll be okay, Trainer! I can handle any distance, and any senior G1 race!
The spring Tenno Sho plaque imbues confidence in Meisho Doto.
